name: 风筝台
Kite Tower
before: 沙地上一座土台，台上一伙沙匪放着一串串黑风筝，风筝尾巴上拴着布条，顺风飘向西边。这是鹞子的传信台：谁家在找账本、谁带着什么旗子、走到了哪里，一只风筝一天就能报到阳关。你们刚到，台上就升起了一只新风筝。

On an earth platform in the sand, a gang of bandits is flying strings of black kites, cloth strips tied to their tails, drifting west on the wind. It's the Hawk's message tower: who's hunting the ledger, what banner they fly, how far they've come. A kite can carry it to Yangguan in a day. As you arrive, a new kite rises from the tower.
after: 放风筝的沙匪被打散了，你们拽下了最后那只风筝。布条上写着：「千字旗到，已过鹞旗岗。」旁边是从阳关飘回来的另一只，回话只有一行：「不许拦。账的事，让他们来问我。」

The kite flyers are scattered and you haul down the last kite. Its strip reads: 'The Qian banner has arrived, past Hawk Banner Hill.' Beside it lies another kite that drifted back from Yangguan with a one-line reply: 'Do not stop them. About the ledger, let them come and ask me.'

name: 车轮寨
Cartwheel Fort
before: 一伙沙匪拆了几十辆大车，用车轮子一圈圈垒成寨墙，远看像一只刺猬。这伙人原是鹞子的手下，前些日子反了出来，自立山头。寨子里关着一个半大的小喽啰，叫小柴，因为不肯跟着反，被绑在车轮上晒了两天，嘴唇都裂了。

A gang of sand bandits has broken up dozens of carts and stacked the wheels ring upon ring into a stockade, a hedgehog from afar. They used to be the Hawk's men, broke away recently and set up on their own. Inside they hold a lanky young underling called Xiao Chai, tied to a wheel in the sun for two days because he refused to join the revolt, his lips cracked.
after: 车轮墙被推倒了，小柴解了绑，喝了半囊水才开口：「鹞子的人现在分成了两拨，老弟兄守着他的规矩，新来的想趁他病了翻天。」他说他知道阳关的路，也知道谁站哪一边，愿意给你们带路。

The wheel wall comes down and Xiao Chai is untied. Only after half a skin of water can he speak. 'The Hawk's men have split in two. The old hands keep to his rules; the new lot want to take over while he's ill.' He knows the way to Yangguan and who stands where, he says, and offers to guide you.

name: 互市旧址
Old Border Market
before: 沙漠中一片残破的土城，从前是关内外互市的地方：东边的木料、西边的粮食在这里交易。互市荒了十年，只剩塌了顶的货栈和一根歪倒的市旗杆。一大伙沙匪占了这里，把货栈当马棚，把市令的衙门当赌场，市簿被撕得一页一页糊了窗户。

A crumbling mud-walled town in the desert, once the border market where eastern timber and western grain changed hands. Deserted ten years, it's all roofless warehouses and a leaning flagpole. A large gang of sand bandits has taken it over, stabling horses in the warehouses, gambling in the clerk's office, and pasting the market register's pages over the windows one by one.
after: 沙匪被逐出土城，市旗重新升起，木商和粮商陆续赶来，互市重开：拿木料换粮食，一天一万二千斤。你们从窗纸上揭下市簿，找到十年前的一笔：「千里号，以粮易木。」老面铺那页账本残页正好补上缺的一角，两边一对：账房在这一笔上算错了，少算了一整车粮。旁边用深墨改了数，像是他后来才发觉。前头的路，他少带了粮。

The bandits are driven out, the market flag rises, timber and grain merchants trickle in, and the market reopens: timber for grain, twelve thousand catties a day. You peel the register pages off the windows and find an entry from ten years ago: 'Qianli caravan, grain for timber.' The torn ledger page from the noodle shop fits its missing corner exactly, and side by side they show it: the bookkeeper got this sum wrong, a whole cartload of grain short. The figure was corrected in darker ink, as if he noticed later. He went into the road ahead with too little grain.

name: 孤烽燧
Lonely Beacon
before: 日记里说的孤墩就在眼前，墩台上飘着一缕细细的烟。一伙沙匪围着墩台，喊着让上面的人把墩里的东西交出来，他们听说那是千里号的护卫留下的宝贝。墩上没人答话，只射下来一支箭，力气已经不大，扎在沙匪脚前一尺。老伍长还活着。

The lone tower from the diary stands before you, a thin thread of smoke rising from its top. A gang of sand bandits surrounds it, yelling for whoever's up there to hand over what's inside: treasure left by the Qianli caravan's guards, they've heard. No answer comes, only one arrow, its force nearly spent, landing a foot in front of a bandit. The old squad leader is still alive.
after: 沙匪被打散了。老伍长靠在墙根，瘦得只剩骨头，手里攥着一块令牌。他说当年他带五个兄弟护送千里号到阳关，鹞子把他们赶了回来，账房给他们写了工钱欠条，说「我算过了，前头的路够走」。「他算错了。」老伍长把伍长令塞给你们：「兄弟们散在关外，拿去兵营，喊一声老兄弟们，他们就来。替我们把那段路走完。」他闭上眼睛，像是终于放下了什么。你们把他葬在墩下。

The bandits scatter. The old squad leader sits slumped against the wall, nothing but bones, clutching a token. He and five men escorted the Qianli caravan to Yangguan, he says. The Hawk turned them back, and the bookkeeper wrote them an IOU for their wages: 'I've done the sums, there's enough for the road ahead.' 'He got them wrong.' He presses the Squad Leader's Token on you. 'My brothers are scattered across the frontier. Take this to the barracks and shout: old brothers! They'll come. Finish that road for us.' He closes his eyes, as if he's finally set something down. You bury him beneath the tower.

name: 河心洲
Midriver Isle
before: 疏勒河中间一片长满红柳的沙洲，一大伙沙匪扎着羊皮筏子在这里劫船。头领是个从阳关跑出来的老骑手，脸上一道刀疤。他不劫钱，只劫人问话：「你们是来找那三百个的？」答「是」的放走，答「不是」的扔进河里。

On a tamarisk-covered sandbar in the middle of the Shule River, a large gang of sand bandits raids boats from rafts. Their chief is an old rider who fled Yangguan, a scar across his face. He doesn't rob for money; he captures people to ask them: 'Have you come looking for the three hundred?' Answer yes and you go free. Answer no and you go in the river.
after: 沙匪投降了。刀疤老骑手说，十年前他在阳关守门，看着鹞子一个一个数那支商队，数到第三百个，是账房。第二天一早，二百九十九个人进了沙海，账房留下来，跟鹞子在帐里坐了一夜。「我就看见这么多，后来怕了，就跑了。」

You storm the isle and the bandits surrender. Ten years ago, the scarred old rider says, he kept the gate at Yangguan and watched the Hawk stand there counting the caravan one by one. Number three hundred was the bookkeeper. Next morning two hundred and ninety-nine went into the Sand Sea. The bookkeeper stayed behind and sat a whole night with the Hawk in his tent. 'That's all I saw,' he says. 'Then I got scared and ran.'

name: 茶骡墩
Tea Mule Tower
before: 长城边一座墩台下拴着二十几头骡子，驮着关里来的砖茶。赶骡子的茶商被一伙兵痞锁在墩台里，兵痞们天天用他的茶煮奶茶。茶商在窗口急得直喊：「那是鹞子订的！每年一驮，一年都不能少！」兵痞们笑他：「鹞子快不行了，谁还管他的茶。」

Two dozen mules laden with brick tea are tethered under a wall tower. The tea merchant is locked inside by rogue soldiers who brew milk tea with his cargo every day. He shouts from the window: 'That's the Hawk's order! One load a year, never a year missed!' The soldiers laugh: 'The Hawk's on his way out. Who cares about his tea?'
after: 兵痞被赶走，茶商被放了出来。他说鹞子每年订一驮好茶，从来不喝，原封不动存着。有一年他忍不住问，鹞子说：「那年有个人跟我喝了一夜酒，第二天一个人进了沙海，说回来要跟我喝茶，把账算完。」茶商叹气：「十驮了，那人还没回来喝。」

The soldiers are driven off and the merchant let out. Every year, he says, the Hawk orders a load of fine tea and never drinks it, storing it untouched. Once he dared ask why, and the Hawk said: 'One year a man drank with me all night, then went into the Sand Sea alone the next day. He said he'd come back to drink tea with me and finish our accounts.' The merchant sighs. 'Ten loads now, and he's never come back to drink it.'

name: 野马谷
Wild Horse Valley
before: 戈壁深处一条山谷，是野马群产驹的地方。一队精悍的大漠响马在谷口下了绊马索，要抓今年的马驹。野马群里有一匹老马格外显眼：身上还套着一副烂了一半的鞍子，鞍袋鼓鼓囊囊，不让任何人靠近。响马说那是千里号跑丢的马，鞍袋里说不定就是账本。

Deep in the gobi is a valley where wild herds come to foal. A tough troop of desert raiders has laid hobble ropes at its mouth to catch this year's foals. One old horse in the herd stands out: it still wears a half-rotted saddle with bulging saddlebags and lets no one near. The raiders say it's a runaway from the Qianli caravan, and the bags might hold the ledger.
after: 响马被打退，绊马索割断了，野马群冲出了谷口。那匹老马跑在最后，回头看了你们一眼，鞍袋松了，掉下来一个小布包。里面不是账本，是一把旧算盘，第三档少了一颗珠子，框上刻着：「备用」。账房连算盘都备了两把，账本却只有一本。

The raiders are beaten back, the ropes cut, and the herd bursts out of the valley. The old horse runs last, looks back at you once, and its loosened saddlebag drops a small cloth bundle. Not the ledger, but an old abacus missing one bead on the third rod, its frame carved 'spare'. The bookkeeper carried two abacuses, but only one ledger.

name: 剃头坡
Barber's Slope
before: 这伙沙匪想投鹞子，被拒了，一气之下自立门户。他们绑了个剃头匠，要剃一个「鹞子头」显得威风。剃头匠胆子小，手一抖，给头领剃了个阴阳头。头领没镜子，觉得挺凉快，下令全寨照着剃。现在个个半边光头，见了人还挺神气。

This gang wanted to join the Hawk, got turned down, and set up on their own in a huff. They kidnapped a barber to give them all 'the Hawk's haircut' for a fierce look. The nervous barber slipped and shaved the chief on one side only. The chief, having no mirror, found it nice and cool and ordered the whole gang to copy it. Now they're all half bald, and strut about very proudly.
after: 半边光头们四散而逃，远看像一群斑马。小柴笑得直不起腰：「鹞子不收他们，是因为他们劫过一个过路的老太太。鹞子的规矩是：不杀过路人，不碰千字旗的货。」剃头匠说，他见过真鹞子，一头白发，是十年前一夜白的。

The half-bald bandits scatter, looking from afar like zebras. Xiao Chai laughs till he can't stand. 'The Hawk wouldn't take them because they'd robbed an old woman on the road. His rules: don't kill travellers, don't touch goods under the Qian banner.' The barber says he's seen the real Hawk: hair white all over, turned white in a single night ten years ago.

name: 黑牙行
Crooked Brokers
before: 互市边上开着一家「牙行」，专门收购「千里号账本残页」，转手卖给想去阳关讨赏的人。秤砣里灌了沙，量纸的尺子短一寸，谁敢说是假货，后院的刀手就出来。门口排着一长溜捧着破纸的人，都盼着自己那张是真的。

A 'broker's house' by the border market buys up 'torn pages of the Qianli ledger' and sells them on to people hoping to claim a reward at Yangguan. Its weights are sand-filled, its rulers an inch short, and anyone who calls the pages fakes meets the blades in the back yard. A long queue clutching scraps of paper waits outside, each hoping theirs is real.
after: 刀手被打倒，牙行被查封。掌柜招认，他们卖出去的残页没有一张拿到过赏钱：鹞子看都不看，只摸一摸纸，就说「不是」。「真账本用的是西边的桑皮纸，」掌柜说，「鹞子一摸就知道。他亲手摸过那本账。」

The blades go down and the brokers' house is shut. The manager confesses that not one page they sold ever earned a reward: the Hawk doesn't even read them. He just feels the paper and says 'no'. 'The real ledger is on western mulberry paper,' the manager says. 'The Hawk knows by touch. He's held that ledger in his own hands.'

name: 狼嚎滩
Howling Flat
before: 这片沙滩是戈壁狼的地盘，一到月圆，狼嚎声此起彼伏。往年鹞子的马队常在这一带巡逻，狼不敢近人；今年鹞子把人马都收回了阳关，狼群胆子越来越大，大白天就敢扑商队，叼走马驹。狼一年下两窝崽，打掉一群，第二年又冒出一群。

This sandy flat is gobi wolf country, and at full moon the howling never stops. In past years the Hawk's riders patrolled here and the wolves kept their distance. This year the Hawk pulled every rider back to Yangguan, and the wolves grow bolder, attacking caravans by day and carrying off foals. The packs whelp twice a year: wipe out one, and another appears the next.
after: 狼群被打散，头狼逃进了沙丘深处。这一阵商路能安生了，可等明年开春，狼崽子长大了，还得再来清一次。附近的人说，鹞子收兵那天起狼就多了，好像连狼都知道，阳关上的人顾不上外头了。

The pack is broken and the lead wolf flees into the dunes. The road will be safe for a while, but when the cubs grow up next spring, you'll have to clear them again. The locals say the wolves multiplied from the day the Hawk withdrew, as if even they knew the man at Yangguan could no longer watch the world outside.

name: 枯井地道
Tunnel Under the Well
before: 顺着枯井壁上的脚窝爬下去，井底横着一条地道，阴风阵阵，那呜呜的声音就是风穿过地道发出来的。地道深处有火光，几个沙匪正撬着一只军箱，箱上刻着「什」字。他们以为里面是千里号的账本，听见脚步声，抄起刀扑了过来。

Climbing down the footholds, you find a tunnel running sideways from the bottom of the well. A chill wind blows through it, and the moaning is air rushing along the passage. Deep inside, firelight: a few sand bandits are prising open an army chest carved with the character Shi, ten. They think it holds the Qianli ledger, and hearing footsteps, lunge with their blades.
after: 沙匪被打跑了。箱子里是一块什长令，压着一张纸条：「我们这一什十人，九年前奉命出关寻千里号，遇沙暴躲进此道，都活了下来。寻了一年，路上无人，账也不在路上。鹞子说，账跟着账房走了。我们散在关外放牧，后来的兄弟，拿这令去营里喊一声，我们都在。」井底的「一、二、三」，是风里留着他们当年点名的回响。鹞子不许人下井，是怕有人拿走这块令。

The bandits flee. In the chest lies a Ten Leader's Token on top of a note: 'We ten were sent out nine years ago to search for the Qianli caravan. A sandstorm drove us into this tunnel; all of us lived. We searched a year. Nobody on the road, and no ledger on the road either. The Hawk said the ledger went with the bookkeeper. We've scattered across the frontier as herders. Brother who comes after: take this token to the barracks and call out. We're all still here.' The 'one, two, three' in the well was the wind carrying their old roll call. The Hawk forbade the well so no one would take this token.

name: 照镜沙
Mirror Sands
before: 一伙沙匪弓手得了一箱铜镜，插在沙丘上，正午把阳光反射进过路人的眼睛，趁人看不见就放箭。可他们最近不怎么劫道了，镜子都对着西边一闪一闪：原来他们替鹞子打镜语，把找账本的人一路的动静报给阳关，一闪一两银子。

A troop of sand-bandit archers got hold of a chest of bronze mirrors and planted them on the dunes, flashing the noon sun into travellers' eyes and shooting while they're blinded. Lately, though, they hardly rob at all; the mirrors all flash westward. They're signalling for the Hawk, reporting the movements of ledger-hunters to Yangguan at a tael per flash.
after: 你们挑了个阴天去打，镜子没了用处，弓手们一下成了瞎子。领头的说，阳关那边回的镜语这个月只有一句，翻来覆去：「千字旗到了没有？」镜子你们拔了一箱，分给了附近的姑娘们。

You attack on a cloudy day, the mirrors are useless, and the archers suddenly can't see a thing. Their leader says Yangguan's only reply this month has been the same question, over and over: 'Has the Qian banner arrived?' You pull up a whole chest of mirrors and give them to the girls of the district.

name: 仙水坛
Holy Water Altar
before: 沙漠里一座土坛，坛上供着泥塑的「沙母娘娘」。一伙自称「沙母教」的沙匪四处传道：千里号的账本是一本「咒书」，三百人就是被它咒进沙里的，谁找它谁就是下一个。他们卖「仙水」辟邪，一碗一两银子，其实是兑了锅灰的井水。

An earthen altar in the desert bears a clay idol of 'Mother Sand'. A gang of bandits calling themselves the Mother Sand sect preach everywhere that the Qianli ledger is a 'cursed book': it cursed the three hundred into the sand, and whoever seeks it will be next. They sell protective 'holy water' at a tael a bowl. It's well water stirred with soot.
after: 沙母教被打散，泥塑推倒，肚子里掉出一堆骗来的银子，还有一本他们自己做的「咒书」，里面画满了鬼。你们把银子分还给了信徒。一个老阿妈呸了一声：「哪有什么咒，那本账是记人家欠账的，最多咒的是欠债的人。」

The sect is scattered and the idol toppled; out of its belly tumble piles of swindled silver and a homemade 'cursed book' full of drawn ghosts. You return the silver to the faithful. An old woman spits. 'Curse my foot. That ledger records what people owe. If it curses anyone, it's the debtors.'

name: 抓丁坡
Press-Gang Slope
before: 坡下的村子里只剩老人和孩子。一伙沙匪打着鹞子的旗号抓丁，把村里的年轻后生拴成一串，说是给鹞子充军。小柴一看就啐了一口：「鹞子从来不抓丁，他只收自愿的。这是秃狼的人。」秃狼是鹞子手下最有野心的头目，正四处拉人。

Only the old and the very young are left in the village below the slope. A gang of sand bandits flying the Hawk's banner is press-ganging the young men, roping them in a line 'to serve the Hawk'. Xiao Chai spits at the sight. 'The Hawk never press-gangs. He only takes volunteers. These are Bald Wolf's men.' Bald Wolf is the most ambitious of the Hawk's chiefs, recruiting everywhere.
after: 绳子割断了，后生们扑回了娘的怀里，秃狼的人反被拴成一串。小柴说，秃狼放话：鹞子快死了，谁跟着他，等他占了阳关，鹞子仓里的东西人人有份。「可那仓里的东西，」小柴压低声音，「鹞子说过，一样都不是他的。」

The ropes are cut and the young men run back to their mothers, and Bald Wolf's men end up roped together instead. Bald Wolf has promised, Xiao Chai says, that the Hawk is dying, and whoever follows him gets a share of the Hawk's storehouse once he takes Yangguan. 'But what's in that storehouse,' Xiao Chai lowers his voice, 'the Hawk has always said none of it is his.'

name: 迷沙窝
Lost Sands Hollow
before: 一场大沙暴把一队骑手困在了沙窝里。他们的马跑了，路标被埋了，水也快喝光了，却还端着刀拦在路上，嗓子哑得像破锣。他们背上插着黑色的鹞子小旗，是鹞子的巡哨，可巡的方向不对：他们本该巡东边，却一直往西走。

A great sandstorm has trapped a patrol of riders in this hollow. Their horses have bolted, the markers are buried, their water's nearly gone, yet they still stand in the road with blades raised, voices cracked like broken gongs. Black hawk pennants on their backs mark them as the Hawk's scouts, but they're patrolling the wrong way: they should be watching east, yet they've been heading west.
after: 巡哨没打几下就扔了刀，跪下来求水。领头的说，鹞子每年派一队人往西走，走到沙海边上，看有没有人从里面走出来。他从怀里掏出一张贴身带着的令：「若见账房，请回阳关，账未算完。」「十年了，」他说，「一次也没见着。」

The scouts throw down their blades almost at once and beg for water. Every year, their leader says, the Hawk sends a party west to the edge of the Sand Sea, to see if anyone has come out. From his shirt he takes an order he keeps close: 'If you see the bookkeeper, ask him to come back to Yangguan. The accounts are not finished.' 'Ten years,' he says. 'Not once.'

name: 半路茶馆
Halfway Teahouse
before: 荒原上一间茶馆，是鹞子手下老弟兄们歇脚喝茶的地方，掌柜是个独臂的老兵。秃狼的人把茶馆围了三天，要逼里面的老弟兄投他。老弟兄们把门板拆下来当盾，在里面一边喝茶一边骂，茶都续到第八壶了，就是不出来。

A teahouse on the open plain where the Hawk's old hands stop to rest and drink, kept by a one-armed veteran. Bald Wolf's men have besieged it for three days to force the old hands inside to join him. The old hands have taken the doors off for shields and sit inside drinking and cursing. They're on their eighth pot and still won't come out.
after: 秃狼的人被打散了，老弟兄们端着茶碗出来，冲你们点点头。一个老骑手说，鹞子十年没睡过一个整觉，每到半夜就起来，站在帐外看西边。「我们守着他的规矩，不是怕他，」他说，「是觉得他心里压着一笔账，得有人来帮他算。」

Bald Wolf's men are scattered and the old hands come out with their teacups and nod to you. The Hawk hasn't slept a full night in ten years, an old rider says. Every midnight he gets up and stands outside his tent looking west. 'We keep his rules not because we fear him,' he says, 'but because there's an account weighing on his heart, and someone has to help him settle it.'
first: 围茶馆的人留下二十几袋炒米、一车干柴、十几坛抢来的酒，还有一面没来得及打出去的大旗，上头绣着「秃狼」两个大字，绣得歪歪扭扭。
The besiegers left behind twenty-odd sacks of fried rice, a cart of firewood, a dozen jars of stolen wine, and a big banner they never got to fly, crookedly embroidered with the words 'Bald Wolf'.
pass: 独臂掌柜每次都沏一壶最好的砖茶，单手倒得一滴不洒，再给你们包上一包茶叶和几块冰糖，说路上嘴里要有点甜。

The one-armed keeper always brews you his best brick tea, pouring one-handed without spilling a drop, and wraps up a packet of tea and some rock sugar for the road: you need something sweet in your mouth out there.

name: 鹰贼窝
Falcon Thieves' Nest
before: 这伙沙匪训了几只鹰，专从天上俯冲下来抓过路人的包袱。最近他们抓的不是钱袋，是纸：谁身上带着「账本残页」，鹰就扑谁。窝里的纸已经堆成了小山，他们打算一张一张送去阳关碰运气。

These sand bandits have trained falcons to stoop from the sky and snatch travellers' bundles. Lately they don't go for purses, but paper: anyone carrying a 'ledger page' gets struck. The paper in their nest is piled into a small hill, and they plan to take it to Yangguan sheet by sheet and try their luck.
after: 沙匪被打跑了，鹰落在你们的旗杆上不肯走，你们把它们放回了天上。那一堆纸你们翻了一遍，没有一张是桑皮纸，没有一张盖着少一颗珠子的算盘印。真的账本，从来就没散落在路上。

The bandits flee, the falcons perch on your flagpole, and you release them into the sky. You go through the pile of paper: not one sheet is mulberry paper, not one bears the abacus seal with the missing bead. The real ledger was never scattered along the road.

name: 封路沙
Road-Closed Sands
before: 沙道上横着一道用木桩和骆驼刺扎成的路障，一伙鹞子的骑手守着，所有往西去的人一律赶回去，说是鹞子的令：「西去之路，本月封闭。」被赶回来的商人在路边骂骂咧咧。骑手们看见你们的旗子，互相看了一眼，还是举起了刀。

A barricade of stakes and camel thorn blocks the sandy road, guarded by the Hawk's riders, who turn back everyone heading west: 'By the Hawk's order, the western road is closed this month.' Merchants sent back curse by the roadside. Seeing your banner, the riders glance at each other, then raise their blades anyway.
after: 骑手被打散，路障拆了。被俘的骑手说，封路是为了挡住那些找账本的人，可令的后半句是：「千字旗来，可放；放之前，试一试他们。」「我们试过了，」他揉着肩膀说，「够了。」

The riders are scattered and the barricade torn down. The road was closed to keep out the ledger-hunters, a captured rider says, but the order goes on: 'If the Qian banner comes, let it pass; but test them first.' 'We've tested you,' he says, rubbing his shoulder. 'That'll do.'

name: 压寨坡
Captive's Slope
before: 坡上的寨子里关着一位关里大官的千金，秃狼要她家拿一千两银子来赎。可寨子里传出来的骂声全是那位小姐的：「饭做得太咸！」「刀磨得太钝！」「就你们这样还想占阳关？」沙匪们个个缩着脖子，像挨骂的学童。

In the fort on this slope Bald Wolf is holding a high official's daughter for a thousand-tael ransom. Yet all the shouting from the fort is hers: 'The food's too salty!' 'Your blades are blunt!' 'You lot think you can take Yangguan?' The bandits hunch their necks like scolded schoolboys.
after: 你们攻进寨子，小姐正坐在头领的椅子上，手里拿着一根马鞭。沙匪们跑得比兔子还快。小姐说她偷听到了秃狼的打算：等鹞子一倒，就抢鹞子仓，把里面的东西全卖了。「我看那里头的东西，」她说，「是别人寄存的。抢寄存的东西，最没出息。」

You storm the fort and find the young lady in the chief's chair with a riding crop. The bandits bolt like hares. She overheard Bald Wolf's plan, she says: the moment the Hawk falls, raid his storehouse and sell everything inside. 'From what I heard, those things belong to someone else, left in his keeping,' she says. 'Robbing a deposit is the lowest thing there is.'

name: 鸣镝坡
Whistling Arrow Slope
before: 坡顶上蹲着鹞子手下的哨探，人手一把带哨子的响箭。远远看见有人过来，就放一支，一声是「有货」，两声是「有兵」，三声是「快跑」。他们看见你们的旗子，一口气放了三支，自己却没跑，拔刀冲了下来。

The Hawk's scouts crouch on the crest, each with whistling arrows. Spot travellers and they loose one: one whistle means 'cargo', two 'soldiers', three 'run'. Seeing your banner, they loose three in a row, but instead of running, they draw blades and charge.
after: 哨探被打散了。审问一个年轻的，他说放三支响箭是鹞子的规矩，可鹞子又说过，见了「那面旗子」不许跑。他说不清是哪面旗子，只记得鹞子说那面旗子上该有一个「千」字。一路上收账本的令、封路的令、试一试的令，原来都在等你们。

The scouts are routed. A young one, questioned, says three whistles is the Hawk's rule, but the Hawk also said that when they see 'that banner', nobody runs. He can't say which banner; only that the Hawk said it ought to bear the character Qian. The ledger order, the road-closing order, the 'test them' order: all along the way, they were waiting for you.

name: 两头营
Two-Headed Camp
before: 秃狼的一伙人和另一伙沙匪合了营，可营里两个头领谁也不服谁：一个说趁鹞子病了马上打阳关，一个说等鹞子死了再去捡现成的。两边吵了三天，连吃饭都分锅。你们来的时候，他们正为谁当先锋吵得不可开交。

Some of Bald Wolf's men have merged with another bandit gang, but the two chiefs won't bow to each other: one wants to attack Yangguan now while the Hawk is ill, the other wants to wait until he dies and pick up the pieces. Three days of arguing, separate cooking pots. When you arrive they're screaming over who leads the charge.
after: 你们一冲，两个头领同时喊「你先上」，结果谁也没上。营散了。小柴说，秃狼最怕的不是鹞子，是鹞子手下那些老弟兄，他们说鹞子不倒，阳关就不许乱。

When you charge, both chiefs shout 'you first!' and neither goes. The camp falls apart. Bald Wolf doesn't fear the Hawk himself, Xiao Chai says, so much as the Hawk's old hands, who say that while the Hawk stands, nobody makes trouble at Yangguan.

name: 山脚酒肆
Foothill Tavern
before: 北山脚下一间酒肆，老板娘姓秦，酿的青稞酒远近闻名。半个月前秃狼的一伙人住了进来，天天喝酒不给钱，喝醉了还砸桌子，说「等我们占了阳关，这酒肆也是我们的」。秦老板娘把剩下的好酒埋进后院，拿着擀面杖坐在门口骂了三天。

At the foot of the northern hills stands a tavern whose landlady, Mistress Qin, brews famous highland barley wine. Half a month ago some of Bald Wolf's men moved in, drinking without paying and smashing tables: 'once we take Yangguan, this tavern's ours too'. Mistress Qin buried her best jars out back and has sat at the door with a rolling pin, cursing them for three days.
after: 秃狼的人被赶跑了，秦老板娘刨出酒坛，酒香飘了满山，酒肆重新开张，好酒好肉拿出来跟你们换。她说鹞子每年三月来一次，一个人坐一夜，倒三百杯酒洒在地上，最后一杯自己喝。「那杯，」她说，「他说是替一个算错账的人喝的。」

Bald Wolf's men are driven off. Mistress Qin digs up her jars, the smell fills the hillside, and the tavern reopens with her best wine and meat to trade. Every third month, she says, the Hawk comes alone, sits all night, pours three hundred cups onto the ground, and drinks the last himself. 'That one,' she says, 'he says he drinks for a man who got his sums wrong.'

name: 望人沙
Watching Dune
before: 沙丘上一间孤零零的土屋，屋前站着一个中年妇人，每天傍晚往西边看，一看就是一个时辰。她的男人是千里号的驼夫，走了十年。她家那峰老骆驼每到半夜就挣开缰绳往阳关走，第二天又自己回来。一伙沙匪看上了这峰「认路的骆驼」，把屋子围了起来。

A lone mud house stands on a dune, and every evening a middle-aged woman stands before it gazing west for two hours. Her husband was a camel driver with the Qianli caravan, gone ten years. Every midnight her old camel breaks its halter and walks toward Yangguan, and comes back on its own the next day. A gang of sand bandits wants this 'camel that knows the way', and has surrounded the house.
after: 沙匪被打跑了。妇人掏出一枚铜铃舌：「他走时留给我，说铃铛不响，就是他在路上停下了，回来再装上。」她说这一带的牲口夜里都往阳关走，到故垒外头跪下，天亮才回来。「它们在等什么，我也在等。」

The bandits are driven off. From her coat the woman takes a small cloth bundle holding a bronze bell clapper. 'When he left he gave me this. He said if the bell doesn't ring, he's only stopped on the road, and when he comes back we'll put it in again.' All the animals around here walk to Yangguan at night, she says, kneel outside the old fort, and come home at dawn. 'Whatever they're waiting for,' she says, 'I'm waiting too.'

name: 沙橇营
Sand Sled Camp
before: 秃狼手下的一大伙人想出了新花样：坐着木头沙橇从高高的沙丘顶上冲下来，快得像箭，一眨眼冲进商队，抢了东西再爬回去。沙丘上满是沙橇划出的长槽，像一张巨大的竖琴。小柴看了直撇嘴：「鹞子的老弟兄要是看见这种打法，能笑掉牙。」

A big crew of Bald Wolf's men has a new trick: riding wooden sleds down from high dune crests, fast as arrows, crashing into caravans and scrambling back up with the loot. The dunes are scored with long grooves like the strings of a giant harp. Xiao Chai curls his lip. 'If the Hawk's old hands saw this, they'd laugh their teeth out.'
after: 你们守在沙丘底下，沙橇一个个冲下来，一个个被掀翻。被俘的人说，他们用沙橇是因为秃狼的马不够：鹞子的马只认鹞子的老弟兄，秃狼的人一上马就被掀下来。沙橇你们给了附近的孩子们，他们一整天都在沙丘上尖叫。

You wait at the foot of the dunes and overturn the sleds one by one. The captives say they use sleds because Bald Wolf hasn't enough horses: the Hawk's horses only accept the Hawk's old hands and throw Bald Wolf's men the moment they mount. You give the sleds to the local children, who scream down the dunes all day.

name: 夜跪滩
Night Kneeling Flat
before: 阳关东边的沙滩上，一伙沙匪做起了「看奇景」的生意：每到半夜，附近的牲口都会从这片滩上走过，往阳关去，沙匪就向过路的商人收钱，一人十文，管看一场「万驼夜跪」。谁看了不给钱，就扣下他的骆驼，让它也去跪。

On the sands east of Yangguan, a gang of sand bandits has opened a 'wonder of the frontier' business: every midnight the animals of the district walk across this flat toward Yangguan, and the bandits charge passing merchants ten coins a head to watch 'the Kneeling of Ten Thousand Camels'. Watch without paying and they keep your camel so it can go kneel too.
after: 沙匪被打跑了。半夜里，你们果然看见一串串牲口从滩上走过，骆驼、马、驴，安安静静，一头都不叫，走到能望见阳关故垒的地方，齐刷刷跪下，头朝西。天快亮时，它们又站起来，各自回家。没有人赶，也没有人能拦。

The bandits flee. At midnight you see it for yourselves: lines of animals crossing the flat, camels, horses, donkeys, silent, not one bellowing. Where the old Yangguan fort comes into view, they kneel all together, heads to the west. Near dawn they rise and go home. Nobody drives them, and nobody can stop them.

name: 夜空栈
Empty-Stable Inn
before: 沙漠中间一座客栈，有个怪名声：住店的客人半夜起来，总发现自家的牲口不见了，天亮又回来了，满膝盖都是沙。一伙沙匪趁机占了客栈，卖「拴驼绳」，一根一两银子，说拴了就不跑。可拴了照跑，绳子还被挣断。店主一家被赶到门外搭窝棚。

An inn in the middle of the desert has a strange reputation: guests who wake at midnight always find their animals gone, and back again at dawn with sand caked on their knees. A gang of sand bandits has seized the inn to sell 'camel ropes' at a tael each, guaranteed to stop them wandering. They wander anyway, snapping the ropes. The owner's family has been thrown out to a lean-to.
after: 沙匪被赶出了客栈，店主一家搬了回去。店主说他家的牲口也跑，十年了，从千里号在这里住过一夜之后就开始了。「我不拴了，」他说，「它们去阳关，天亮就回来，比人守信用。」门口挂上了一块牌子：「开拓队来，分文不取。」

The bandits are thrown out and the family moves back in. Their own animals wander too, the owner says. It started ten years ago, after the Qianli caravan stayed a night here. 'I've given up tying them,' he says. 'They go to Yangguan and they're back by dawn. More reliable than people.' A sign goes up by the gate: 'For the pioneers, free of charge.'
first: 沙匪在店里藏了六十多捆苜蓿草料、二十袋豆子、一大堆没卖出去的「拴驼绳」，还有一口装满碎银的陶罐，都是骗来的绳子钱。
The bandits hid over sixty bundles of alfalfa, twenty sacks of beans, a heap of unsold 'camel ropes', and a clay jar of silver, all rope money they swindled.
pass: 店主一家早早烧好炕，老板娘煮一锅羊肉汤，孩子们把你们的旗子拿去掸了灰，再插回门口，说这样夜里过路的人都知道开拓队住在这儿。

The family has the beds heated early and the landlady cooks mutton soup, while the children take your banner, beat the dust out of it, and plant it back by the gate, so travellers in the night will know the pioneers are staying here.

name: 丝绸窖
Silk Cellar
before: 戈壁上一座塌了的汉代驿站，地下有一个窖。一队精锐的骑手守着窖口，不是秃狼的人，是鹞子最老的弟兄，十年来轮班看守，谁也不让靠近。秃狼的人前天来抢过一回，死了好几个。窖口上方的沙地里，夜里总有几峰骆驼来跪着。

Beneath a collapsed Han-dynasty post station on the gobi lies a cellar. An elite troop of riders guards its mouth, not Bald Wolf's men but the Hawk's oldest companions, taking shifts for ten years and letting no one near. Bald Wolf's men tried to raid it the day before yesterday and left several dead. At night, a few camels always come to kneel on the sand above it.
after: 老弟兄们打得很硬，最后让开了路：「打得过我们，就配看。」窖里码着几百匹丝绸，都贴着千里号的封条，墙上钉着账房写的寄存单：「回程取，鹞子代管。」代管十年，一匹没少。

The old companions fight hard, but in the end stand aside. 'If you can beat us,' says their leader, 'you've earned a look.' Inside lie hundreds of bolts of silk, each sealed 'Qianli caravan': before entering the Sand Sea, the caravan left what it couldn't carry here. The deposit slip in the bookkeeper's hand is nailed to the wall: 'To be collected on return. Held in the Hawk's keeping.' Ten years in his keeping, and not one bolt missing.

name: 无人寺
Empty Temple
before: 戈壁上一座小寺，和尚早就走光了，可寺里的钟每天清晨都会自己响三下。秃狼的人不信邪，想把铜钟拆下来熔了换刀，刚爬上钟楼，钟又响了，吓得差点摔下来，可他们还是不肯走，说「阳关要打仗，缺铜」。

A small temple stands on the gobi. The monks left long ago, yet every dawn the bell rings three times by itself. Bald Wolf's men don't believe in such things and want to melt the bell down for blades. As soon as they climb the tower, it rings again and they nearly fall, but they still won't leave: 'There's going to be a fight at Yangguan. We need bronze.'
after: 秃狼的人被赶跑了。钟后面缩着一个瘦小的小和尚，手里拿着钟锤。他说师父三年前去了阳关，想劝鹞子放下心事，到现在还在阳关给鹞子做饭。师父托人带回过一句话：「鹞子心里那笔账，他一个人算不完，得等一个人回来。」

Bald Wolf's men are driven off. Behind the bell huddles a skinny little monk with the striker. Three years ago his master went to Yangguan to persuade the Hawk to let go of his burden, and he's still there cooking for the Hawk. The master once sent back one message: 'The account in the Hawk's heart is not one he can settle alone. He has to wait for someone to come back.'

name: 截信坡
Letter Thieves' Slope
before: 驿道从这里过，一伙秃狼的人专截驿卒，不抢马、不抢钱，只抢信，拆开一封封读，从里面找能敲诈的事。被截下的信堆了半间屋子，最底下压着一个落满灰的皮囊，封口上盖着一个独眼鹞子的火漆印，从来没被打开过。

The post road passes here, and a gang of Bald Wolf's men ambushes the couriers for letters, not horses or money, reading them for blackmail material. Intercepted letters fill half a room, and at the very bottom lies a dusty leather pouch sealed with a one-eyed hawk in wax, never opened.
after: 沙匪被打跑了，你们把信重新封好交给驿卒。那个皮囊里是鹞子十年前写给朝廷的信，字写得很笨：「千里号二百九十九人已入沙海，账房于次日独往。我放之，若有罪，罪在我。乞朝廷遣人寻之。」驿卒说这封信当年在这里被劫，朝廷从来没收到过。

The bandits flee and you reseal the letters for the couriers. The pouch holds a letter the Hawk wrote to the court ten years ago, in clumsy characters: 'Two hundred and ninety-nine of the Qianli caravan have entered the Sand Sea. The bookkeeper followed alone the next day. I let them go. If there is guilt, it is mine. I beg the court to send someone to find them.' The courier says it was robbed here back then. The court never received it.

name: 沙暴口
Sandstorm Mouth
before: 两座沙山之间的风口，十天里有八天刮沙暴。一伙沙匪戴着牛角片磨的护目镜，专在沙暴里打劫。可他们说，最怕的不是官兵，是半夜沙暴里那些从风口穿过去的牲口：一声不吭，一队一队往阳关走，沙子打在脸上都不眨眼。

The wind gap between two sand mountains has sandstorms eight days out of ten. A gang of sand bandits wearing goggles ground from horn robs only in the storms. But what they fear most, they say, isn't soldiers but the animals that pass through the gap in midnight storms: silent, file after file heading for Yangguan, not blinking as the sand strikes their faces.
after: 你们蒙着湿布在沙暴里打赢了这一仗，抢下了牛角镜。那天半夜，风口里果然走过一队牲口，最前头是一峰老骆驼，脖子上挂着一只没有铃舌的铜铃，铃壳上一个「千」字。沙匪们缩在石头后面，谁也不敢出声。

Wet cloths over your faces, you win the fight in the storm and take the horn goggles. That midnight a file of animals does pass through the gap, led by an old camel wearing a bronze bell with no clapper, Qian on its shell. The bandits huddle behind the rocks and nobody dares make a sound.

name: 黑石矿
Black Rock Mine
before: 北山脚下有一座黑石矿，石头能烧，比柴火还暖。鹞子每年从这里买几十车黑石，夜里在阳关上烧一整夜的火。秃狼的人占了矿，抓了二十多个村民挖石头，一天只给一顿稀粥，还放话：「断了黑石，看鹞子夜里还怎么熬。」

At the foot of the northern hills is a mine of burnable black rock, warmer than firewood. Every year the Hawk buys dozens of cartloads to keep a fire burning all night on Yangguan. Bald Wolf's men have seized the mine and forced twenty-odd villagers to dig on one bowl of gruel a day, boasting: 'Cut off his black rock and see how the Hawk gets through his nights.'
after: 秃狼的人被打跑了，挖矿的人走出矿洞，脸黑得只看见眼白。他们说鹞子买黑石从不还价，夜里那堆火是烧给西边看的：「他说那年那些人进沙海，回头看得见这堆火，就知道往哪走。」他们送了你们一车黑石，说替他们捎给阳关。

Bald Wolf's men are driven off and the miners walk out, faces so black only the whites of their eyes show. The Hawk never haggles over black rock, they say, and that fire at night is for the west to see: 'He says when those people went into the Sand Sea, if they looked back and saw this fire, they'd know the way home.' They give you a cartload and ask you to take it to Yangguan for them.
